_note: The cost ledger (KC-0212, spec D18, AGENTS §0 r6): every resource Clawco Sky runs on, with its monthly cost in øre and the revenue trigger that allows it. Nothing paid is switched on (aktiv: true) before paid MRR covers it: the trigger is paid MRR ≥ mrrGange × the line's cost, counted cumulatively over the active paid lines in this order. Sky reads this file by path (sky/src/delt/omkostninger.ts) and the tenant app shows it as the owner card in Kø (src/omkostninger/regnskab.ts); both validators are held to test/fixtures/omkostninger-konformitet.json. Prices with fra: true are the cheapest listed option, converted at the rate in kilde and with 25 % Danish VAT, since Henrik is not VAT-registered (D17).

kira-home.note: Henriks egen server, allerede betalt. Kontrolplanet og betaens tenants kører her.

cloudflare-tunnel.note: Gratis. Kundernes skyer nås gennem tunnelen; ingen port åbnes på kira-home.

mail-gratis.note: Loginlinks og kvitteringer på udbyderens gratis niveau (KC-0178).
